notes: Encoded from Energy Kinetics' own page only. The page repeats the 'Style 1' heading for the F-form; it is filed here as style-2 to keep ids distinct. No parent/successor beyond the page's own parent company is claimed.

styles.notes: Page positions 2nd & 3rd numerical digits = year, 4th & 5th = month (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open [1,3] and [3,5]. All-digit serial, so character and digit counting agree. Page marks the prefix 29907.

styles.era: Letter + 11 digits, year + month (split month positions)
styles.notes: Counting follows the Wave 3 Nordyne/Dayton lesson: the page states year = 3rd & 4th numerical digits and month = 5th & 8th numerical digits. Under digit-only counting the page's own example F10608063248 gives year '60' and month '83' (invalid, above 12), so that reading is falsified by the page's own example; under character counting the same example gives year '06' (2006) and month '06' (June, split positions 5th char '0' + 8th char '6'), so character counting is this page's convention and is shipped. Page example shown as 'F 10608063248' (space stripped by normalization).
